description: List the participant resources configured for your GrowSurf program, including drafts. Results stay in display order. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Pass the `id` returned by growsurf_create_campaign to configure or operate a program you just created, without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_list_program_resources

resources.description: The program's resources in participant display order, including drafts.

items.description: One ordered participant resource. Private file delivery fields are not returned.

createdAt.description: The creation time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

description.description: Optional supporting text shown to participants.

moderationStatus.description: The latest security review status for the file. `PENDING` and `APPROVED` files can be published and downloaded; a `REJECTED` file is blocked everywhere, including one that was already published.

isPublished.description: Whether eligible participants can receive the resource.

updatedAt.description: The latest update time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

url.description: The HTTPS destination for a `LINK`; otherwise `null`.

title: List Program Resources
